before.observation: Chromium both cores did not resume nonzero PCM after direct context close; Firefox did.

nativeStopCorrection.after: Direct player-owned audio route remains until terminal destroy; stop/restart reuses one context. Final source/main/legacy browser cases all pass on Chromium and Firefox.
nativeStopCorrection.semantics: Internal context ownership changed; Promise stop, stopped recognizer and later play remain public behavior.

limitation: Windows WebKit 26.6 native WebAudio unsupported; not Safari/device evidence.
Installed public TS/module consumers remain PKG-ASR-04.
Native captured fallback topology, volume/mute, CORS and device matrix remain PKG-ASR-05.
Queue overload explicitly stops capture after the larger of 60 seconds or two configured chunks; existing subtitles keep their hide deadline; caller cancellation is outside plugin ownership.
